verdicts.reason: A scatters the five botanical chips around the can at random positions and inconsistent sizes (BLOOD ORANGE is huge, WILD HONEY and ROSEMARY are tiny), and buries the 'Build Your Mix' CTA as a small pill among them. It also promotes the 'Flavours vary by region' fine print to subtitle size and shrinks the logo to a speck in the bottom-left corner. B also inflates the fine print into a subtitle, and its chips are jammed into a tight vertical stack. The CTA sits on top of that stack at nearly the same size as the chips, so it barely stands out, and the can is pushed to the far left with dead space above it. Still, B keeps the botanicals grouped, puts the logo centred, and the eye can follow it, so it is the less bad of the two.
